rules.statement: A local manager or attorney has the power to sign a statement required for business registration under the Ordinance, even if the individual resides outside the Colony.
rules.supporting_quote: "I regret I am unable to agree with the learned Judge as to his construction of sections 5 and 19 of the Ordinance on this point. Whether or not, as Mr. Hayley has argued, even in the absence of section 19 from the Ordinance, the local manager or attorney would have power to sign the statement it is not necessary to decide. I would hold therefore that there has been no failure to comply with the provisions of the Ordinance in this respect and would hold that this ground of appeal also must succeed."
